summary: Kerb on Swann Road start; homes 20 m off, apartments near the rest.

best_section.where: Start of the stretch, opposite the retail shop and houses

drivers.seclusion: Best section has a shop and apartments ahead, detached homes 21-24 m across the road; apartments 8-9 m from 40 m on.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside parking lane; cars parked along it. No Stopping Any Time sign sits at the start, so room is limited.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs; 1P Mon-Fri daytime only, so overnight is outside the limit.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign 2 m from the start
sun_shade: Open at the start with some tree shade from the north side; trees shade the middle.
cannot_judge: Which side the No Stopping sign applies to
